title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for the aperture D must be correctly calculated as 0.32 cm.

title: Lens Formula
description: Important Criteria: The application of the lens formula to find the image distance v must be correctly shown.

title: Diffraction Blur Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the diffraction blur using the Rayleigh criterion must be correctly performed.

title: Defocus Blur Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the defocus blur must be correctly derived from the geometry.

title: Equality Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition for setting the diffraction blur equal to the defocus blur must be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of the lens formula will result in a deduction.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to include the factor of 1.22 in the diffraction blur calculation will lead to a deduction.
